title: Splitting a work order moves a line that holds an inactive part
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create an active part, part A, for this test.
  • Create an open work order, work order 1, for this test, with two approved lines: line 1 with no parts and line 2 holding part A.
  • Set part A inactive after it is on line 2.
  • Start on work order 1, on its Lines tab.
custom_steps:
1. Tick the checkbox of line 2.
  2. Click Split work order in the bulk menu.
  3. Click the button that confirms the split.
  4. Open the new work order the split made.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Line 2 is ticked.

Step 2:

  • The split confirmation opens.

Step 3:

  • The split completes with no inactive-part refusal.

Step 4:

  • The new work order holds line 2 with part A, and work order 1 keeps line 1 only.
